mapper.sql: select column_id, table_id, column_name, column_comment, column_type, java_type, java_field, is_pk, is_increment, is_required, is_insert, is_edit, is_list, is_query, query_type, html_type, dict_type, sort, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from gen_table_column
mapper.select: SELECT cast(col.name as nvarchar(128)) as column_name, case when col.is_nullable = 1 then '0' else '1' end as is_required, case when exists (SELECT 1 FROM sys.index_columns ic JOIN sys.indexes i ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id WHERE i.is_primary_key = 1 AND ic.object_id = col.object_id AND ic.column_id = col.column_id) then '1' else '0' end as is_pk, col.column_id as sort, cast(ep.value as nvarchar(max)) as column_comment, case when col.is_identity = 1 then '1' else '0' end as is_increment, cast(t.name as nvarchar(100)) + (case when t.name in ('varchar', 'nvarchar', 'char', 'nchar') then '(' + case when col.max_length = -1 then 'max' else cast(columnproperty(col.object_id, col.name, 'precision') as varchar) end + ')' else '' end) as column_type FROM sys.columns col JOIN sys.types t ON col.user_type_id = t.user_type_id JOIN sys.tables tab ON col.object_id = tab.object_id LEFT JOIN sys.extended_properties ep ON ep.major_id = col.object_id AND ep.minor_id = col.column_id AND ep.name = 'MS_Description' WHERE tab.name = #{tableName} AND tab.type = 'U' AND schema_name(tab.schema_id) = SCHEMA_NAME() ORDER BY col.column_id
mapper.insert: insert into gen_table_column ( table_id, column_name, column_comment, column_type, java_type, java_field, is_pk, is_increment, is_required, is_insert, is_edit, is_list, is_query, query_type, html_type, dict_type, sort, create_by, create_time )values( #{tableId}, #{columnName}, #{columnComment}, #{columnType}, #{javaType}, #{javaField}, #{isPk}, #{isIncrement}, #{isRequired}, #{isInsert}, #{isEdit}, #{isList}, #{isQuery}, #{queryType}, #{htmlType}, #{dictType}, #{sort}, #{createBy}, getdate() )
